findings.highlight: I curse the person that’s not here
findings.evidenceJa: いもしないアーチャーに悪態をついて
findings.governingReading: I curse at Archer, who is not even here
findings.explanation: The explicit target of Shirou’s embarrassed outburst is generalized, weakening the growing Archer fixation.
The archaic style or character of Issei’s reading becomes the physical age of the book.
Shirou’s actual drink loses its temperature and culturally ordinary preparation.

findings.highlight: the muddled feeling of that tea
findings.evidenceJa: 昆布茶のドロッとした感じ
findings.governingReading: the thick, slightly viscous feel of kombu tea
findings.explanation: A disliked mouthfeel is mistranslated as cognitive or visual confusion.

findings.highlight: chatting about meaningless things with a student
findings.governingReading: making small talk with a student
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s rare ordinary sociability is disparaged as discussion of meaningless subjects.

findings.governingReading: perhaps two equally straitlaced men get along
findings.explanation: Their rigid seriousness and propriety become refusal to change their minds.

findings.highlight: like I got hit in the head with a hammer
findings.evidenceJa: 後頭部を叩かれたような感じ
findings.governingReading: as though I had been struck in the back of the head
findings.explanation: The exact bodily location is lost and a hammer is invented.

findings.evidenceJa: ごわん、と二度目の衝撃
findings.governingReading: With a heavy “gowan,” the second shock hits
findings.explanation: The repeated impact sound linking Shirou’s two realizations disappears.

findings.highlight: This is something I can’t ignore
findings.governingReading: Whatever its source, this was information I could not ignore
findings.explanation: Shirou’s reservation about Issei’s odd framing and the information’s provenance disappears.

findings.highlight: because he’s from the Ryuudou Temple
findings.evidenceJa: 柳洞寺に住んでるから
findings.governingReading: because he lives at Ryuudou Temple
findings.explanation: Current residence is turned into origin or affiliation.
A constraint imposed by a fleeting chance becomes Rin and Shirou choosing impatience.

findings.highlight: he’ll just sleep in for two days with a cold
findings.evidenceJa: 二日風邪で寝込む程度
findings.governingReading: he will merely be bedridden with a cold for two days
findings.explanation: An involuntary two-day illness becomes voluntary oversleeping.

findings.highlight: I’m the one that doesn’t get you!
findings.evidenceJa: そっちこそわからないヤツだなっ
findings.governingReading: You are the incomprehensible one here!
findings.explanation: The English reverses who is being labeled unable to understand: Shirou calls Rin incomprehensible, not himself.

findings.highlight: I do not think food will be bad
findings.evidenceJa: 食事はあまり問題ない
findings.explanation: Saber’s claim about digestion and combat readiness becomes a judgment that food itself will not be bad.

findings.highlight: we’ll have to make sure to beat him if we’re going to attack
findings.evidenceJa: 仕掛けるのならそれは必殺
findings.governingReading: if we strike, it must be decisive and lethal
findings.explanation: Shirou’s recognition that the ambush allows no second chance is weakened into generic victory.

findings.highlight: Caster, the one attacking all the people in this town
findings.evidenceJa: 町の人間を次々と襲っているキャスター
findings.governingReading: Caster, who has been attacking townspeople one after another
findings.explanation: A continuing series of victims becomes an attack on the entire town population.

findings.highlight: something I can easily put magical energy into
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力を通しやすい得物
findings.governingReading: a weapon through which magical energy passes readily
findings.explanation: A property of conducting power through the weapon becomes simple infusion into it.

findings.governingReading: husband-and-wife swords, read as a married pair
findings.explanation: The gendered paired identity and spoken `meoto` reading of Kanshou and Bakuya disappear.

findings.governingReading: I could fight as a full-fledged combatant
findings.explanation: Shirou’s wish to stand as a complete, independent fighter is reduced to adequate performance.
